slides.title: Programs break
slides.text: Every programmer makes mistakes. A mistake in a program is called a bug. Finding and fixing it is called debugging.
slides.alt: The Debug Lab opens a program that does not work: Bolt waits at the start while the broken program fills the tray.

focus.cue: This program does not work yet: it has a bug

slides.title: Expected and actual
slides.text: Ask two questions. What did I expect Bolt to do? What did Bolt actually do? The bug is where those two first split apart.
slides.alt: The broken program stepped to its turn left block: Bolt climbed three squares and now faces the wall, away from the flag.

focus.cue: Expected: Bolt turns toward the flag
Actual: he turned left, away from it
They split at this block: turn left

slides.title: Step, stop, fix
slides.text: Do not delete everything. Step through the program one block at a time and stop at the first surprise.
slides.alt: Stepping one block at a time: the first block is lit in the tray and Bolt has moved exactly one square.

focus.cue: Step lights one block at a time: this one
Watch each block until the first surprise

slides.title: One too many
slides.text: Bolt goes one square too far? Look at the numbers. A repeat count that is one too big is a very common bug.
slides.alt: Debug Lab level 2: the flag is five squares from Bolt, but the program says repeat 6 times, move.

focus.cue: But the program says repeat 6 times: one too many

slides.title: Done means tested
slides.text: A fix is not done when it looks right. It is done when you run it again and Bolt does what you expected.
slides.alt: The fixed program sits in the tray: the wrong turn left has become turn right, ready to run again and be tested.

focus.cue: The one changed block: turn right
Now run it again to test it

words.means: find a bug and fix it

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Debug Lab and fix all 7 programs. Use Step, change as few blocks as you can, and run it again to test.
slides.alt: The Debug Lab opens a program that does not work: Bolt waits at the start while the broken program fills the tray.

focus.cue: Fix it with as few changes as you can
